title: Okon's Picture of Manglefeet
description: Okon's Picture of Manglefeet — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Okon

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go into Level 1 of MutantMania. Clobber anyone who looks suspicious until you retrieve Okon's collectable. Return it to Okon in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Okon

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Okon's Inaction Figure, Part 1

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go into Level 1 of MutantMania. Clobber anyone who looks suspicious until you retrieve Okon's collectable. Return it to Okon in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

Pleathe help! I need your help! I was thowing around my most fav'rite thing in all the world ever, my thigned picture of Menathing Manglefeet the Murderouth, the world champ and betht fighter ever, but thome guy grabbed it and ran into Level 1 of the MutantMania dungeon! I'm not thuppothed to go out-thide. I'll never get it back on my own! Pleathe help me! PLEATHE!!!

Turn-in:

My autographed picture of Manglefeet! You got it back! You're the betht ever! Next to Manglefeet, I mean! My papa left me some money. You can have thome for helping me!

Objectives:

  • Signed Picture of Manglefeet ×1

Client level range: 80–100
